resources.string: Values become permanent PDF content and can no longer be edited.
This PDF has no fillable form fields.
This PDF does not contain a fillable AcroForm.
Dynamic XFA forms are not supported.
This signed form is read-only because changes would invalidate its signature.
The form could not be saved.
The completed form was saved as a new document.

Open a PDF with AcroForm fields in the viewer and choose Fill form. Complete text fields, check boxes, radio buttons, and selection lists, then save a new copy. You can optionally flatten the fields so their values become permanent. Signed forms are read-only, and dynamic XFA forms are not supported.
Interactive AcroForm PDFs can be completed on-device and saved as a new copy, with optional field flattening and Unicode fallback fonts for multiple writing systems.
